actions.simulatorHint: This parcel is with the practice courier. Moving it along here acts as the courier's report; it does not touch a real courier.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?

rebook.weightInvalid: Enter a whole number of grams.
rebook.reasonHint: Optional. Kept in the parcel log.

advance.title: Move the parcel along (sandbox)
advance.description: You are acting as the practice courier. The order and the customer follow the parcel as they would with a real courier.
advance.noteHint: Optional. Appears in the parcel log.
